question: How is the śakti form produced in the portion allotted to Rudra?
premises: A three-part rounding process is specified.
The resulting form is called śakti.
The location is the worship portion allotted to Rudra.
inference: By three-part rounding in the worship portion allotted to Rudra, the śakti form is produced.
plain_english: By rounding in three parts within the portion allotted to Rudra, the śakti form is produced.
